linux.notes: Round 22 la (scripts/linux_flat_la.py: the audit metric, a reference flat pixel off when ours differs by more than 2 levels, only glyph pixels within 2 px of text ink set apart, symbolic icons never set apart; best placement within 3 px). The ring is a drawn band of 5.85 / 4 px corner radii (GTK: about 6 / 4; the generic border drew 5.7 / 3.7), and in the combo entry the button's divider lies over the ring's end as in GTK. gaps: Antialiasing of curved edges is not exact (the 'steep' pixels, which the flat-pixel metric does not count): the focus ring corners differ by up to 9 levels on about 20 to 26 pixels per ring, the symbolic icons' edges (search, peek eye) by a few levels
